The KingType GPT-C828V 8-Port GPON OLT is a carrier-grade Optical Line Terminal (OLT) designed for high-capacity FTTH (Fiber to the Home), FTTB (Fiber to the Building), FTTO, and enterprise fiber access networks. Built for Internet Service Providers (ISPs), telecom operators, and large-scale fiber deployments, this OLT delivers reliable GPON connectivity, centralized management, and outstanding network scalability.


Featuring 8 GPON PON ports, the KingType GPT-C828V provides high-bandwidth optical transmission, enabling efficient delivery of broadband, voice, and IPTV services over a single fiber infrastructure. With advanced Layer 2 networking capabilities and OMCI-based ONU management, it simplifies deployment, monitoring, and maintenance while ensuring stable network performance.


The GPT-C828V supports essential networking technologies including VLAN, QoS, ACL, IGMP Snooping, DHCP Relay, and multiple management interfaces such as Web GUI, CLI, SNMP, and Telnet. Its compact rack-mount design and carrier-grade architecture make it an ideal solution for expanding GPON access networks.


Key Features


  • 8 GPON PON Ports
  • GPON Downstream Speed: Up to 2.488 Gbps per PON port
  • GPON Upstream Speed: Up to 1.244 Gbps per PON port
  • Supports FTTH, FTTB, FTTO, and ISP broadband deployments
  • OMCI-based ONU auto-discovery and remote management
  • Advanced Layer 2 switching features
  • Supports VLAN, QoS, ACL, DHCP Relay, and IGMP Snooping
  • Web GUI, CLI, SNMP, and Telnet management
  • Carrier-grade security and traffic management
  • High reliability with stable optical transmission
  • Standard 1U rack-mount design
